spec_atomic_units: The module 'top_module' implements a 4-digit BCD counter.
Inputs include a clock signal (clk) and a synchronous active-high reset signal (reset).
Output consists of a 16-bit register (q) representing the BCD digits.
Output includes a 3-bit enable signal (ena) for controlling the incrementing of upper digits.
The clk input triggers counting on the rising edge.
The reset input resets all outputs (q) to zero on the next rising edge of clk.
Enable signals are generated based on the state of lower digits reaching 9.
Critical timing paths involve clk and reset signals.
The reset signal must be stable and captured on the next rising edge of clk.
Counting occurs on the positive edge of clk using non-blocking assignments.
Enable signals are generated based on conditions of lower digits reaching 9.
